title: The Bridge of the Cape Route
author: Kestrel Fairweather
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
